title: IPC admin.endpoints.remove result
description: What a removal of an ADDED endpoint did. A REFUSAL IS AN ANSWER: `outcome: refused` names its rule, nothing written. `removed`: in one overlay write before the answer the entry and every overlay member keyed by the id are gone, a live lease was revoked (its epoch in `revoked_epoch`), and a peer the removal took from the last set that held it was disconnected. An id no entry holds is the error `EndpointUnknown`. `detail` is for a log.

refused.$comment: Present exactly when outcome is refused, checked in this order: authored (a config.yaml entry, turned off and never removed); default (the default endpoint: the client moves the default first).

revoked_epoch.description: The lease epoch the removal revoked, when one was live; only on removed.
